name: Icertis
description_en:
Icertis is an enterprise contract-intelligence platform. Its current portfolio distinguishes Engage for drafting and negotiation, Operate for contract operations and obligations, and Analyze for portfolio intelligence. Icertis Contract Management (ICM) is the governed contract system within that wider portfolio.

This profile focuses on ICM and how its structured repository, workflows, role controls and enterprise integrations support contract operations. Vera Copilot and other agents appear across the portfolio; their presence on a platform page does not establish that every capability is included in one ICM subscription.
description_zh:
Icertis 是企业合同智能平台。当前产品组合区分用于起草谈判的 Engage、用于合同运营及义务的 Operate，以及用于组合分析的 Analyze；Icertis Contract Management（ICM）是其中受治理的合同系统。

本文重点介绍 ICM 如何通过结构化合同库、流程、角色控制和企业集成支持合同运营。Vera Copilot 与其他 Agent 分布于整个产品组合，平台页出现某项能力，不表示一个 ICM 订阅包含全部功能。

core_features.explanation_en: Ingest existing agreements into searchable structured data with indexing, relationships and version history.
core_features.explanation_zh: 把现有协议转成可搜索结构化数据，并保存索引、关联及版本历史。

core_features.explanation_en: Use defined workflows and role-based controls for contract ownership and administration.
core_features.explanation_zh: 以明确流程及角色控制管理合同责任和系统配置。

core_features.explanation_en: The product describes working through SAP, Microsoft, Salesforce and Workday.
core_features.explanation_zh: 产品介绍通过 SAP、Microsoft、Salesforce 和 Workday 开展合同工作。

sections.title_en: Make legacy contracts usable in enterprise workflows
sections.title_zh: 让历史合同进入企业流程
sections.en: ICM describes using Discover to ingest legacy and third-party contracts and convert unstructured documents into searchable data. A proposed migration sample could include a master agreement, statement of work and later amendment. Preserve their relationship and verify parties and operative dates before using the extracted fields in workflow. Searching a repository successfully is not evidence that an amended obligation was interpreted correctly.
sections.zh: ICM 介绍用 Discover 导入历史及第三方合同，把非结构化文档转成可搜索数据。可用主协议、工作说明书及后续补充协议组成迁移样例，保留关联，并在字段用于流程前核对签约方和有效日期。成功搜索合同库，不证明正确理解了被修改的义务。

sections.title_en: Define an operating model before configuring automation
sections.title_zh: 配置自动化前定义运营模型
sections.en: The product supports standardised workflows, role-based ownership and self-service administration. Drafting can start from approved templates and clauses, with review in Microsoft Word and deviations tracked across teams. Define who creates a request, who may change the template, when finance or legal must approve, and how a changed contract re-enters review. The documentation does not supply the customer’s approval policy.
sections.zh: 产品支持标准化流程、按角色分配责任及自助管理；可从批准模板和条款起草，在 Microsoft Word 中审阅，并跨团队跟踪偏差。应确定谁发起申请、谁能改模板、何时需财务或法务批准，以及合同修改后如何重新审查。文档不会替客户制定审批政策。

sections.title_en: Separate ICM from the wider Vera portfolio
sections.title_zh: 区分 ICM 与更广的 Vera 产品组合
sections.en: The current site groups drafting and redlining under Engage, contract management and obligations under Operate, and analytics under Analyze. The sales page asks an expert to recommend the appropriate solutions. When evaluating a natural-language answer or agent, identify the actual module, licensed data scope and permitted action. A generated summary should be traced back to its agreement before a business decision; no AI accuracy or autonomous execution was tested here.
sections.zh: 当前网站把起草及修订归入 Engage，合同管理及义务归入 Operate，分析归入 Analyze；销售页由专家推荐合适方案。评估自然语言回答或 Agent 时，应明确具体模块、授权数据范围及可执行操作。业务决策前应把生成摘要追溯到协议；本文未测试 AI 准确率或自主执行。

sections.title_en: Verify the system boundary of the integration
sections.en: ICM lists SAP, Microsoft, Salesforce and Workday as enterprise environments where users can work with contracts. This is product-scope evidence, not a tested guarantee for a particular object, custom field or bidirectional conflict rule. Bring the relevant tenant, identity model, contract IDs and source-of-truth decisions to implementation planning. Exact connector licensing, API limits and failure replay require separate confirmation.
sections.zh: ICM 列出 SAP、Microsoft、Salesforce 和 Workday 等可开展合同工作的企业环境。这能证明产品范围，不能作为具体对象、自定义字段或双向冲突规则的实测保证。实施规划应明确租户、身份模型、合同标识及各字段权威来源；连接器许可、API 限制和失败重放需另行确认。

sections.en: The official demo page routes buyers to an expert and provides no verified public payable amount. Pricing, user types, AI modules, obligations, analytics and implementation must therefore be confirmed in a scoped quote. Do not infer a free operating plan from the demo invitation. ICM is relevant to complex, shared enterprise contracting; a team seeking one occasional signature may not justify the data and governance setup. Public source availability does not establish an open-source licence, and no customer-run installation was verified.
sections.zh: 官方演示页引导买方联系专家，未核实公开应付金额。因此价格、用户类型、AI 模块、义务、分析及实施都需在明确范围的报价中确认。演示邀请不能推导出免费运营套餐。ICM 面向复杂、跨团队企业合同工作，偶尔签署的小团队可能不值得承担数据与治理配置。公开产品资料不等于开源许可，本文也未核实客户自行安装。
